notes: The Duplorcator's selecting, ghost, planting and undo as host rules on the native copy seams: clicking a brick within reach selects the stack up from it (full trust, no public bricks, 5000 bricks for admins and 500 for others, a selection wait of 1 s for admins and 3 s for others, as its Return to Blockland preferences defaulted), lights it cyan for a moment, and shows the whole copy as a ghost; planting plants each brick that fits and Ctrl+Z takes it back. /saveDup and /loadDup keep and load copies by name on the host (and load v20 duplication files there); a duplication over the limit asks whether to load what fits, as its message box did. Drawing the wand with nothing selected says Normal Mode, and the cancel key lets a selection go. A copy of over 50 bricks (its "Max Flood Bypass") plants a second after the last plant for admins and three seconds for others (its planting timeouts), with the flood error; a selection cut short by the limit shows the limit error. Its "Client Loading/Saving" and "Can Load Saves" preferences are off, as Return to Blockland defaulted them and as the Add-On left them without it, so the host takes no duplication uploaded from a player's computer: /clientLoad says so and /reloadDup has no cached duplication. Here the copy belongs to the wand: taking out a brick puts the wand and its ghost away and the wand brings the copy back, and the ghost shows up to 10,000 bricks spread across the copy (the original ghosted its first 500).
